# Collect song_ids from album library and playlist library, with pagination

page_limit = 20

# album library
album_song_ids = set()
album_lib_pages = 0
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    album_lib_pages += 1
    for alb in page:
        for sid in (alb.get('song_ids') or []):
            album_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1

# playlist library
playlist_song_ids = set()
playlist_lib_pages = 0
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    playlist_lib_pages += 1
    for pl in page:
        for sid in (pl.get('song_ids') or []):
            playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1

print('album_lib_pages', album_lib_pages)
print('album_unique_song_ids', len(album_song_ids))
print('playlist_lib_pages', playlist_lib_pages)
print('playlist_unique_song_ids', len(playlist_song_ids))

song_ids_union = all_song_ids | album_song_ids | playlist_song_ids

print('song_ids_not_in_song_library', len(song_ids_union - all_song_ids))

# Fetch details for any song_ids not already present in song_map
missing_ids = sorted(list(song_ids_union - set(song_map.keys())))
print('missing_song_ids_count', len(missing_ids))

# Fill in missing title/artists
for i, sid in enumerate(missing_ids):
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=int(sid))
    # Note: api doc shows show_song has no access_token param.
    title = s.get('title','')
    artists = s.get('artists', []) or []
    artists_str = '|'.join([a.get('name','') for a in artists])
    song_map[sid] = (title, artists_str)

print('song_map_total', len(song_map))
# verify all union ids now in map
print('missing_after_fill', len(song_ids_union - set(song_map.keys())))

# Prepare rows
rows = []
for sid in song_ids_union:
    title, artists_str = song_map[sid]
    rows.append((sid, title, artists_str))

# Sort deterministically by title then artists then id
rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1].lower(), x[2].lower(), x[0]))
print('rows_count', len(rows))
print('first_row', rows[0] if rows else None)
print('last_row', rows[-1] if rows else None)

# Build CSV content and write to ~/backups/spotify_library.csv
from datetime import datetime

def csv_escape(val):
    s = str(val) if val is not None else ''
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

backup_dir = '~/backups'
backup_file = '~/backups/spotify_library.csv'

# Ensure directory exists
fs_token = globals().get('fs_token')
assert fs_token

dir_exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=backup_dir, access_token=fs_token)
print('dir_exists_before', dir_exists)
if not dir_exists:
    # create recursively
    create_dir_resp = apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=backup_dir, access_token=fs_token, recursive=True)
    print('create_dir_resp', create_dir_resp)

# Prepare CSV content
header = ['Title', 'Artists']
lines = [','.join(header)]
for sid, title, artists_str in rows:
    lines.append(csv_escape(title) + ',' + csv_escape(artists_str))
content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('csv_lines', len(lines)-1, 'content_len', len(content))

# Write file
file_exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=backup_file, access_token=fs_token)
print('file_exists_before', file_exists)

if file_exists:
    upd = apis.file_system.update_file(file_path=backup_file, content=content, access_token=fs_token)
    print('update_file_resp', upd)
else:
    create_resp = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=backup_file, content=content, access_token=fs_token)
    print('create_file_resp', create_resp)
